# End-of-run summary lists loop stops

## What to build

`watchLoops` (`src/agents/loop.ts`) calls `onLoop(label, why)` each time it stops an agent that kept repeating the same tool calls; `src/runner/run.ts` passes it a callback that only logs today (`[${label}] stopped: ${why}; retrying`). Record every stop and report it at the end: `RunEnd` in `src/runner/events.ts` gains `loopStops?: { label: string; why: string }[]`, `run.ts` collects the stops from that callback and includes them in the `run:end` event, and `summaryContent` in `src/ui/Summary.tsx` adds a `Loop stops` section, one line per stop `<label>: <why>`, only when there is at least one. Both the Ink summary and the plain `summaryLines` use `summaryContent`, so both show it.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/runner/events.ts` (lines 75–93) — `RunEnd`
- `src/runner/run.ts` (line ~258) — `const provider = teeOutput(watchLoops(ctx.provider, config.loopDetection, (label, why) => log(...)), events);`
- `src/runner/run.ts` (lines 320–345) — `runEnd(...)`, which emits `run:end`; add `loopStops` there when the list is not empty
- `src/ui/Summary.tsx` (lines 47–80) — `summaryContent`: sections are `{ heading?, lines }`; e.g. `if (notes.length > 0) sections.push({ heading: "Notes", lines: ... })`
- `src/ui/Summary.test.tsx` — summary tests build a `RunEnd` by hand
- `src/runner/run.test.ts` — test "stops a task agent stuck repeating one tool call and restarts it with the reason": the fake provider's `{ loop: 8 }` attempt makes task 2's first attempt loop

## Patterns to follow

**Optional `RunEnd` fields are spread in only when present:**
```ts
...(merge ? { merge } : {}),
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/runner/events.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `loopStops?: { label: string; why: string }[]` on `RunEnd`, with a JSDoc line.

### UPDATE `src/runner/run.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: a `const loopStops: { label: string; why: string }[] = []` next to the provider; the `onLoop` callback pushes `{ label, why }` and still logs; `runEnd` adds `...(loopStops.length > 0 ? { loopStops: [...loopStops] } : {})`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/ui/Summary.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: after the findings sections, `if (end.loopStops?.length) sections.push({ heading: "Loop stops", lines: end.loopStops.map((s) => `${s.label}: ${s.why}`) })`.

### UPDATE tests

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `src/ui/Summary.test.tsx`, a `RunEnd` with two loop stops shows the `Loop stops:` heading and both lines in `summaryLines`; without `loopStops` there is no such heading. In `src/runner/run.test.ts`, extend the loop test (or add one next to it) to assert the `run:end` event's `loopStops` is `[{ label: "2", why: expect.stringMatching(/^it made the same tool call 5 times/) }]` (subscribe to `run:end` on a `RunEmitter` passed through `runDiamond`'s `extra.events`).
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/ui src/runner`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A run whose task 2 looped once ends with `RunEnd.loopStops` holding that stop, and the summary shows `Loop stops:` / `2: it made the same tool call 5 times in a row: …`
- [ ] A run without loops has no `loopStops` and no section
- [ ] Tests pass: `npx vitest run src/ui src/runner`

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/ui src/runner
```

Run every command with the graph-execution run variables unset, so the tests never touch a live run:
`env -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUNS_ROOT -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_READY_FILE <command>`.
Stop only processes you started, by PID. Never use `pkill`/`killall` by name or pattern: other agents and graph-execution itself run on this machine.
